name: Non-Violent Self Defense
body:
The answer is never violence.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to channel positive energy, base attack bonus +1, 1st level divine caster, theck.

Benefit(s): Add +2 to the damage of any attack that deals non-lethal damage.
